sin.name: countdown-outside-block-until
sin.description: A contribution counts tool uses itself to work out how long an agent has left before it is held, so the count, its line and its block are its own.
sin.rule: Hold an agent after a grace with OpenHold(agent, AGENT_MESSAGE, condition, Interval(ToolUseWindow(n)), COUNTDOWN.agent_message("{left}")): the step's StoredAgentViewReader counts an open hold's grace uses, says the countdown and holds the agent.
